## Flagship Software Applications & Portals

### 1. HDTalk (Real-Time Communication Platform)
- Live URL: https://hdtalk.onrender.com
- Description: A high-performance real-time web communication platform designed and built by Er. Himanshu Dwivedi. Utilizes WebSockets and WebRTC for persistent, zero-latency duplex audio/video and messaging streaming.
- Core Stack: JavaScript (ES6+), WebSockets, WebRTC, Node.js, Render Cloud.

### 2. Progress Computer Institute Official Portal
- Live URL: https://progresscomputerinstitute.gt.tc
- Description: Institutional digital management platform engineered for Progress Computer Institute. Features student course registration, syllabus discovery, inquiry intake, and digital academic administration.
- Core Stack: PHP, MySQL, Responsive CSS, JavaScript.

### 3. PrepWithHD (Academic Student Portal)
- Domain: Computer Science Engineering Academic System
- Description: Centralized resource sharing portal providing polytechnic diploma students with structured semester roadmaps, syllabus notes, and exam study modules.
- Core Stack: PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap 5.

### 4. Progress Typing Test (Bilingual Typing Evaluator)
- Domain: Interactive Web Diagnostics
- Description: A high-precision bilingual typing speed test tool measuring dynamic WPM, net accuracy, and error tracking supporting dual Hindi (Kruti Dev / Mangal) and English script evaluation.
- Core Stack: Modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3.
